Case studies

Two campaigns in more detail: what was tested and what came back.

TikTok ads for a piano learning app

The goal was simple: create scroll-stopping TikTok ads that drive curiosity, clicks, and conversions. Eight creatives were tested side by side to find the winners.

  • 7.36%overall CTR
  • 12,164clicks
  • 165,209impressions

The four best creatives reached CTRs of 31.58%, 29.10%, 28.71% and 28.22%.

Strategy that worked

  • Hook-driven storytelling in the first 2 seconds
  • Before vs after and curiosity-based angles
  • Short, native TikTok-style videos
  • Emotional triggers and real parent pain points
  • Clear value: easy, fast, fun learning
  • Multiple creative tests to find winners

Key takeaway: high-retention hooks, curiosity and native TikTok creative produced strong CTRs and click volume while keeping the cost per click low.

TikTok Shop GMV Max test

A TikTok Shop GMV Max campaign run for 7 days (11 to 18 May), letting TikTok’s automated bidding optimise for gross merchandise value.

  • 17.93xROI
  • $155.25revenue
  • $8.66ad spend
  • 54orders
  • $0.16cost per order

This is a small-budget test. ROI usually tightens as spend increases, so the result is best read as a strong starting signal that is worth scaling carefully, not a guaranteed rate at larger budgets.
